entries.objective: Implement BlackCell's versioned alpha-v2 kernel, AGY provider boundary, nullable provider accounting, operator TUI projection, and Kernform 0.2 integration.

results.summary: AGY 1.1.7 was integrated and fixture-tested through its stdin-driven plan/sandbox process contract without Gemini CLI. The host-owned v2 plan compiler, bounded repair/replan/escalation state machine, append-only replay and terminal snapshots, pre-execution policy, metadata-only telemetry, typed Praxis candidates, four-pane TUI, and Kernform 0.2 compile/check/init boundary passed focused tests and a disposable sibling round trip over 40 managed files.

entries.objective: Verify the complete BlackCell alpha implementation and preserve frozen historical evidence.

results.summary: Ruff, formatting, and ty passed. The CI-style full gate passed 1572 tests with 2 explicit live-environment skips and 86.08% combined coverage against the unchanged 86% threshold. The rootless Podman acceptance passed separately, including non-root/read-only isolation, credential non-leakage, health, persistence, and restart recovery. Selective mutation testing killed all 14 AlphaV2PolicyKernel.route mutants after adding explicit partial-verification and exact-attempt-limit assertions. Frozen runtime-v1 evidence remained byte-identical.

unresolved_risks: The live Codex integration test remained intentionally skipped because BLACKCELL_CODEX_MODEL was not configured; the live AGY route was exercised instead.
Fourteen pre-existing ResourceWarning reports for test-owned SQLite connections remain non-failing technical debt.

entries.objective: Close the BlackCell production alpha with the public generated-plan route, RFC 10008 run queries, replay hardening, edge-case coverage, and final deterministic verification.

results.summary: The existing public v1 daemon now admits generated versioned plans and feeds the bounded alpha-v2 kernel without adding a second scheduler or API. RFC 10008 QUERY provides strict, authenticated, cache-aware, read-only run discovery. Events, snapshots, artifact digests, cancellation fences, cumulative budgets, plan-scoped idempotency, dependency-head safety, OTel correlations, Praxis candidates, and the four-pane TUI are covered by focused and adversarial tests. The complete repository gate passed 1589 tests with 2 explicit opt-in/live-environment skips; the rootless Podman acceptance passed separately; Ruff, format checking, and ty passed; and selective telemetry mutation testing killed 81 of 81 mutants. No new dependency was added, and frozen runtime-v1 paths were unchanged.

unresolved_risks: A provider subprocess cannot be force-cancelled in flight; BlackCell rechecks cancellation and deadlines before every subsequent effect, commit, and verifier action.
AGY does not report exact tokens or monetary cost, so those fields remain explicitly unknown rather than fabricated as zero.
PraxisLedger output is a typed promotion candidate only; this alpha performs no automatic external ledger write.

No live Codex provider call was run because no model was configured, and no live AGY call was added to the final broad gate; both provider ports remain proposal-only and are covered by deterministic adapter tests.

This BlackCell checkout is not itself Kernform-managed, so direct project conformance correctly returns KF-STATE-001; sibling-contract interoperability is exercised through the adapter and disposable-project tests.
entries.next_step: Await explicit commit or publish authorization; no commit, push, deployment, or live external write was performed.

entries.objective: Complete the final BlackCell alpha trust-boundary audit, repair replay and policy binding gaps, and prove the final source state with maintained gates.

results.summary: Policy decisions now bind the exact run, plan, task, attempt, capability, path set, and destructive flag; the executor rejects replayed decisions; provider failures preserve unknown usage; and replay validates exact event payloads, goal and draft lineage, dependency readiness, action identity, workspace identity, base commits, evidence semantics, terminal state, and checkpoint structure before append or rehydration. The focused alpha surface passed 69 tests after the final adversarial additions. The maintained repository gate passed 1596 tests with 2 explicit opt-in skips and 86.08% branch-aware coverage. The rootless Podman test passed, Ruff, formatting, ty, and diff checks passed, AGY reported 1.1.7, and all 81 configured telemetry mutants were killed. The diagnostic historical runtime-v1 verifier correctly remained outside this alpha gate and reported generated SBOM drift against the current tree; its frozen paths were not modified.

unresolved_risks: A provider subprocess cannot be force-cancelled in flight; BlackCell prevents every later effect after a cancellation or deadline fence.
AGY 1.1.7 does not expose exact token or monetary usage, so those values remain explicitly unknown.
No live Codex or AGY provider call was authorized for this final gate; both proposal-only ports were verified deterministically.
PraxisLedger integration emits typed promotion candidates but performs no automatic external write.
The frozen historical runtime-v1 evidence bundle does not attest the current alpha worktree and its verifier reports generated SBOM drift; the bundle remains unchanged and out of scope.
Fourteen pre-existing non-failing ResourceWarning reports for test-owned SQLite connections remain technical debt.
